jobs.description: ## Company: Qualcomm Technologies, Inc. ## Job Area: Engineering Group, Engineering Group > CPU Engineering General Summary: About the Role You will contribute to a Python-based random test generation (RTG) framework and its companion assembler library that together form the core of a RISC-V CPU design-verification toolchain. The RTG drives a JIT-style, simulator- coupled generator that produces ELF binaries exercising the RVA23.1 ISA — including privileged modes, virtual memory, interrupts, vector, and cryptography extensions.
